meta.name: TVF Tripling
meta.description:
Divorced, jobless, hopeless. Three siblings plan a road trip together. Chandan, Chanchal & Chitvan. Together they start a hilarious journey, to find themselves and their relations.

Rated TV-PG · Returning Series · First aired 28 Aug 2016 · India · Language: Hindi · 21 min
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: YouTube, TVFPlay

videos.title: Toh Chalein...?
videos.overview: Chandan reaches Mumbai to find that Chitvan is a DJ at a pub. Chitvan forgets that Chandan is coming to see him after years. As the brothers meet each other once again, an unplanned road trip begins.

videos.title: Ab Kidhar...?
videos.overview: Chandan is divorced, Chitvan is broke, and Chanchal is apparently faking her pregnancy. They are in a crisis, and they are together. Where will this road trip lead them?

videos.title: Right, Left Ya Seedha...?
videos.overview: Chandan, Chanchal, and Chitvan leave Jodhpur and hit the road. On their journey, they lose their way in the desert.

videos.title: Aage Tiraaha Hai...
videos.overview: As if the road trip was not eventful enough, Chitvan’s Tiago gets stolen. Stuck in the middle of the desert without a ride, the siblings wonder what to do next.

videos.title: Pahunch Gaye Kya...?
videos.overview: The siblings go their separate ways. But this road trip of a lifetime has only one destination, home.

videos.title: Mada Faka
videos.overview: Chandan is the author of the bestselling book 'Tripling'. Chitvan is the star of the book and is excited about it being adapted into a movie. But, Chanchal does not feel the same way.

videos.title: Phir Se Tripling
videos.overview: The trio is back together and has hit the road. Chanchal is annoyed and Chandan feels apologetic. What could be the reason?

videos.title: Kabootar Ja Ja Ja
videos.overview: Chandan, Chanchal, and Chitvan are now on a road trip with a purpose. They happen to meet Prince Alexander and his gorgeous Begum Zainab. Where are they headed?

videos.title: Bandhu Re
videos.overview: The siblings manage to thread the clues and connect some dots. They meet a Samaritan detective. What are they seeking?

videos.title: Raasta Jahan Le Chale
videos.overview: It is always about the journey and the destination only makes it sweeter. What awaits the three siblings?
